# Conflict Rule 5 ## Declaring war
[italic][color=#b8860b]Every round starts with a TSF/PDV ceasefire. Your PDA shows the war level.[/color][/italic]
- Only the [color=#1a9fb5]Colonel[/color] and the [color=#a4885c]Grand Vizier[/color] can declare war, using their [bold]war declarators[/bold]. -- War starts when [bold]both[/bold] have declared. The war level is then [color=#d93c3c][bold]HOT[/bold][/color]. -- If only one side declares, nothing changes. They can use the declarator again to take it back.
- You need an [color=#2e9e4f]RP reason[/color] to declare war, and you should make demands or try to talk first. -- Declaring with no reason falls under the [textlink="commander rule" link="MonolithRuleRoleplayNineCommandingRoles"].
- Ending a war works the same way: both sides use their declarators again and the war level goes back to [color=#1a9fb5][bold]COLD[/bold][/color]. -- When that happens, stop fighting and stop [textlink="striking outposts" link="MonolithRuleConflictFourPortStriking"].
- In an [bold]Escalation[/bold] round, talks break down 30 minutes in. The war level goes [color=#d93c3c][bold]HOT[/bold][/color] and the declarators can't end it.
- While COLD, factions can hire contractors for escort, transport and info, but [color=#d93c3c][bold]not[/bold][/color] to attack the other faction for them.
- No Colonel or Grand Vizier this round? Ahelp if the war level needs to change.
